decision.observation: Clear progress: 8 mph, gear 1, red X cleared, all dots dark, and landmarks have moved substantially (bales now lower-left and behind, more of the lane visible ahead). The car sits on the tarmac with the lane running up-screen and bending slightly left past a large blue puddle on its right edge; white posts and barrels line both verges.
decision.hypothesis: Momentum is good and the car is inside the lane. The lane's continuation leans left around the puddle, so a short throttle-left hold should follow it while staying on tarmac.
decision.memory: The plain 1.0s W after a short steered hold is what finally climbed the verge here and reached 8 mph with landmarks displaced — this pairing is the reliable exit from the barrel-field bend.
